_comment: Copy this file to ../mcp_servers.json (project root) and fill in real servers. The runtime reads project_root/mcp_servers.json by default; override with WLWL_MCP_CONFIG_PATH. Each server entry needs `command` (the executable) and optionally `args`, `env`, `cwd`. wlwl-ass spawns the subprocess on demand and speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio. Untrusted servers can do anything they're configured to do — review before adding, same risk class as code_run.
